status: external inputs; restored and hash-checked by fetch_inputs.py; ignored by Git
publication_note: The three field recordings the texture models were fitted to, each released under CC0 1.0 on its source page (checked again on 17 October 2026). They are needed only to refit or compare the models; rendering reads the models alone. BigSoundBank serves its WAV files through a download form, so they are restored from the rain work's archive or a copy of it on the research drive; the Freesound file is its public high-quality MP3 preview, whose original FLAC needs a login. A size or hash mismatch stops the restore.
